purpose: Define when an observation becomes a promoted learning memo and where that learning must be captured before it is treated as part of the production-grade operating system.

required_evidence: target contract, runbook, template, or backlog destination
blocked_conditions: Evidence is speculative or not tied to inspected repo state.
The proposed memo would weaken auth, billing, tenancy, audit, rate-limit, webhook, approval-gate, or rollback expectations.
The proposed memo requires runtime behavior changes but lacks a scoped work item, tests, rollout plan, and rollback plan.

current_promotion.lesson: Retry-safe release-readiness work must quarantine the current dirty state before refreshing mission metadata or committing inherited WIP. Prior retry evidence can be preserved, but the active mission needs its own wrapper manifest so PR reviewers can distinguish current blockers from historical or superseded ones.
current_promotion.rollback_note: Revert the metadata-only JSON manifests, current and prior .jarvis quarantine bundles, local .codex/reports export if present, .gitattributes archived-patch rules, production profile, PR evidence, release-readiness notes, and advisory validator changes from this node. No Cloudflare worker rollback is required for this change by itself.

non_goals: This file does not authorize automatic code changes from observations.
This file does not replace human review for protected surfaces.
This file does not deploy services or change Cloudflare configuration.
contract_scope: This learning memo promotion manifest defines how daily observations become advisory production-grade operating-system evidence. It does not change runtime behavior, dependencies, migrations, workflow triggers, deploy behavior, billing behavior, auth behavior, tenancy logic, provider webhooks, approval gates, or shared API contracts.
